hero.subtitle: I believe in the power of ideas and technology's ability to make them real. With skill and creativity, I build tailor-made digital solutions aligned with each client's needs and goals.

about.paragraph1: I'm a passionate React developer with 3+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications. I specialize in crafting intuitive interfaces that combine beautiful design with exceptional functionality.
about.paragraph2: When I'm not coding, you'll find me contributing to open-source projects, writing technical articles, or exploring new design trends.

highlights.expertiseDesc: Specialized in building scalable web applications with modern technologies and best practices.
highlights.cleanCodeDesc: Writing maintainable, well-documented code that scales.
highlights.performanceDesc: Optimizing speed and efficiency in every project.
